title: Onboarding & Listing Specialist
description: We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We operate under a co-hosting model — property owners retain their listings, reviews, and branding while we handle operations, guest experience, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028. Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end. Role Mission Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea ---------- mber succeeds or struggles. Core Responsibilities Owner-Facing Onboarding • Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline. • Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor. • Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond. • Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management. Listing Build & Optimization • Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model). • Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion. • Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging. • Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate. Pricing Setup • Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves. • Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules. • Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable. • Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in. Operational Handoff • Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks. • Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives. • Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days. Process Improvement • Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed. • Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality. • Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks. Required Experience & Skills • 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent. • Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or ---------- listings from scratch. • Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez). • Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond). • Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls. • Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details. • Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes. Preferred (Not Required) • Prior experience in hospitality, property management, or client onboarding. • Experience with Breezeway, Slack, Salesmsg, and GetClearing. • Design eye for listing photos and descriptions. • SEO or listing optimization experience on major OTA platforms. Non-Negotiable Traits • Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip. • Owner-facing confidence. You can hold a call with a $500K+ property owner and make them feel informed, respected, and confident in Divergent. • Process thinker. You build systems, not one-offs. • Ownership mindset. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this." • Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. You stay steady, clear, and solution-oriented. What We Offer • Competitive hourly rate for a qualified STR operator. • One of the most strategically important roles in the company — onboarding directly drives growth and retention. • Quarterly performance reviews with bonus opportunities. • Direct access to the owner (Nick) for strategic decisions. • Long-term role with growth potential as we scale to 200+ properties. • Professional development, coaching, and 1:1 time with leadership. Hiring Process 1. Resume and written application — confirm STR onboarding experience. 2. 2-minute Loom video introduction — walk us through a property you onboarded from scratch. 3. First interview (30 minutes) with Divergent leadership. 4. Paid trial project ($75–100): Draft a 5-step onboarding plan with timelines for a sample property, write the owner welcome email , and identify the top 3 risks for this specific property. 5. Reference checks — minimum 2 written references with specific questions. 6. Owner call with Nick — cultural fit and final decision. 7. 30-day paid trial starts.

description: OPERATIONS & AI SYSTEMS ASSOCIATE Location: Remote, working U.S. Pacific Time hours Type: Part-time contractor to start, 10 to 25 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time Reports to: Christian Johnston, Founder Compensation: Based on experience and competency, with structured raises at 30/90/180 days and KPI-based bonuses on top of base. For the right person, this can expand into full-time work after the initial period. As the company grows, there is also a path from contractor status into a more formal employment role, depending on performance, availability, location, and mutual fit. ABOUT OODA OODA Management is a San Diego-based short-term rental property management company building the next generation of how short-term rentals are run. Short-term rental management is genuinely hard to scale. Every property is different, every guest is different, every owner is different, every vendor is different, and every situation requires judgment. Most companies hit the same wall: they either deliver great personalized service at small scale, or they grow and the service quality quietly falls apart. We are building the company that does not make that trade. We are small and AI-native by design. We use AI tools, automation, and tight operating systems to deliver service at a level legacy property managers cannot match without hiring far more people. This role is for someone who wants to join that operating system from the inside. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a general operations support role with an AI systems growth path. You will be assigned into one of our operating divisions, such as guest communication, maintenance coordination, cleanings, owner support, reservations, vendor coordination, or internal operations. You will start by doing the actual work. That part matters. You cannot improve a system you do not understand. You cannot train AI on a workflow you have never lived. You cannot build better SOPs, templates, escalation rules, or automations unless you know where the real friction is. So the path is simple: Learn the division Do the work Document the patterns Identify what breaks repeatedly Help improve the workflow Help train AI and automation around the work Grow into more ownership as the company scales This is not a basic VA role. We are not looking for someone who only wants to complete tasks forever. We are looking for someone who can become excellent inside an operating function, then help us make that function smarter, faster, and more scalable. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Every operating division at OODA has the same core challenge: There are lots of small decisions happening all the time. A guest asks a question. A cleaner reports a problem. A vendor texts back late. An owner needs an update. A maintenance issue needs triage. A task is missing context. A process works 80% of the time, but fails in edge cases. Most companies solve this by hiring more people. We are solving it by building better systems. The person we want is not just someone who says, “I completed the task.” The person we want says: “Why did this task exist?” “Why did this break?” “What information was missing?” “What should the SOP say?” “What could AI handle next time?” “What should still require a human?” “How do we make this easier for the next person?” That is the mindset. You will do real operational work, but the long-term opportunity is to help build the system behind the work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your exact responsibilities will depend on the division you are assigned to, but may include: Responding to guest, owner, vendor, or tea ---------- ssages Coordinating maintenance, cleanings, inspections, or property tasks Updating internal task systems so the team always knows what is happening Following SOPs, checklists, templates, and escalation rules Identifying issues that need human judgment Escalating problems clearly and correctly Tracking repeated questions, bottlenecks, delays, and recurring problems Helping improve SOPs, templates, checklists, and workflows Using AI tools to draft, summarize, classify, organize, and improve work Helping train AI-assisted workflows with real examples from the business Giving feedback on what the system gets right and wrong Helping turn messy real-world operations into cleaner repeatable processes You do not need to be a software developer. But you should be excited to work in a company where the goal is to use AI, automation, and operational discipline to make the business better every week. THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. But we are not hiring for a temporary task list. We are building a team. As OODA grows, each operating division will need people who can own more responsibility. Guest communication, maintenance, cleanings, owner support, vendor coordination, internal QA, AI training, process improvement, and operations management all become more important as we scale. The best people in these seats will not just do the work. They will help define how the work should be done. That means: Better SOPs Better AI prompts Better message templates Better escalation rules Better quality control Better dashboards Better reporting Better training data Better workflows between humans and AI For the right person, this can become a full-time role after the initial period. As OODA grows, we want to build long-term roles around the people who prove they can own real parts of the operation. That may mean expanded hours, full-time contractor work, a formal employment role, division ownership, team leadership, or a more specialized AI operations position. The starting point is operations. The growth path is ownership. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is: COMMUNICATION Excellent in written English Strong in spoken English preferred Fluent Spanish strongly preferred Clear, calm, and professional Able to explain issues without drama or confusion Able to write like a thoughtful human, not a script or translation tool TEMPERAMENT Calm under pressure Reliable during the agreed schedule Detail-oriented Comfortable with repetitive work at first Hungry for more responsibility over time Not too proud to start by doing the work directly JUDGMENT Knows when to solve and when to escalate Follows SOPs without becoming robotic Notices patterns Thinks in root causes Can handle ambiguity without freezing Can be trusted with real operational responsibility SYSTEMS AND AI Comfortable learning new software tools Curious about AI, automation, and process improvement Interested in helping train and improve AI-assisted workflows Able to use tools like ChatGPT thoughtfully Excited by the idea of doing the work first, then helping improve the system You should be the kind of person who completes a task correctly, then asks: “Why did this take so many steps, and how could we make it better?” That mindset matters more than any single tool on your resume.
